responsibility: Contains the scheduling description for the Xilinx PowerPC 405 auxiliary floating-point unit. It models the APU FPU’s issue, add/subtract, multiply, divide, and square-root resources and assigns latencies to floating-point loads, stores, compares, arithmetic, multiply-add/subtract, divide, and sqrt classes for cpu=ppc405 when the Xilinx floating-point hardware is in use.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem header, this machine description file is the scheduler model for the Xilinx auxiliary FPU, defining automata, functional units, and instruction latencies/reservations for ppc405 floating-point operations rather than target macros.
